title: Cross moment identity for derivative thresholds
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $p$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, and let $i,j\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$ be distinct coordinates. The expected product of the two input signs and the two thresholded discrete derivatives of $p$ equals the expected product of the crossed discrete derivatives of those threshold functions.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube
$i,j$ are coordinates in the sign cube
